scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @pttzzz/web-example && npm run build -w @pttzzz/minimal
scripts.build:minimal: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @pttzzz/minimal
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @pttzzz/core && npm run build -w @pttzzz/browser
scripts.verify: npm test && node --test scripts/smoke-helpers.test.mjs && npm run build && npm run lint && node scripts/smoke-packages.mjs
scripts.test: npm test -w @pttzzz/core && npm test -w @pttzzz/browser && npm test -w @pttzzz/web-example && npm test -w @pttzzz/minimal
